URL: https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-infantry-platoon-commander-killed-by-hezbollah-drone-in-southern-lebanon/
TITLE: IDF infantry platoon commander killed by Hezbollah drone in southern Lebanon
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-16 (Saturday evening announcement)
SOURCE: Times of Israel

KEY FACTS:
- Cpt. Maoz Israel Recanati, 24, platoon commander in Golani Brigade's 12th Battalion, from Itamar
- Killed by Hezbollah explosive drone attack in southern Lebanon on Friday
- Was set to marry fiancée Rani in one month per Netanyahu statement
- 7th IDF soldier killed in southern Lebanon since ceasefire began
- 20th soldier killed since hostilities escalated amid the Iran war (plus one civilian contractor)

WEEKEND OPERATIONS:
- IDF says it struck ~100 Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon over the weekend
- Targets: surveillance posts, weapon depots, terror infrastructure
- Strikes in Tyre area among others
- IDF shot down several Hezbollah drones over southern Lebanon
- Drones triggered sirens in Western Galilee border communities
- Hezbollah launched rockets and mortars at IDF troops in south Lebanon — no injuries

LEBANON CASUALTIES (state NNA reported):
- Strikes on 2+ dozen villages Saturday including one 50km from border
- New exodus of residents toward Sidon and Beirut

CEASEFIRE STATUS:
- Israel and Lebanon envoys met in Washington — agreed 45-day ceasefire extension Friday
- Hezbollah opposes negotiations, accuses Lebanese government of "series of free concessions" to "the enemy"
- UN chief Antonio Guterres "welcomes" extension, "urges all actors to fully respect cessation of hostilities"
- Ceasefire has held in Beirut and inland; US has allowed Israel to strike threats
- Hezbollah renewed conflict by attacking Israel in March amid US-Israel war on Iran
